skill.summary: Maximize deep work with focus sessions, distraction logging, and productivity tracking

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Focus & Deep Work.

- Introduces guided focus sessions with Pomodoro, Ultradian, and custom timers.
- Enables distraction logging without interrupting workflow.
- Provides productivity tracking with session summaries and weekly/monthly statistics.
- Automates environment setup (notifications silenced, apps blocked, etc.) for distraction-free work.
- All data stored locally—no cloud syncing or server uploads.
